exchange_rule: Services exchange OpenAPI, AsyncAPI/CloudEvents, and canonical references. Direct cross-service SQL is prohibited.

connectors.next_action: Set EA_OIDC_ISSUER, EA_OIDC_AUDIENCE, and EA_OIDC_JWKS_URL to the Keyverse deployment before exposing domain commands.
Consume the pinned CloudEvent envelope, canonical asset URI, and provenance schemas instead of publishing a local envelope copy.
Link Data/AI context objects by canonical URI only. Do not copy glossary, lineage, or certification facts into this store.
Accept observed physical-schema evidence as reviewable provenance references. Keep snapshots in pg-erd-cloud.
Store inferred relations as proposed or inferred truth only. Require an explicit reviewed command before they become authoritative.
Publish architecture and lifecycle change events for workspace context. Do not open a SQL path from naruon into this database.
Keep CI, review, and release policy aligned with the organization .github repository rather than inventing a local governance fork.
